item.description:
Volna 1.0.7

  • Text goes in where you are typing. In browser text boxes, editable pages, web tables and some apps, Volna sometimes put your text on the clipboard instead of typing it. It now pastes into the app in front, as your own ⌘V would, and keeps the text on the clipboard too wherever it cannot check the result.
  • Paste Last Dictation in the menu bar menu puts your last dictation into the app you were using.
  • A clear message when a permission is missing. If Volna is not allowed to type, it says so, at start and after a dictation, and offers to open the setting.
  • The panel stays in one place. The recording panel and every Volna message now appear at the bottom centre of the screen you are using, never at the top or beside the text box.
  • ⌘W closes Volna's windows, and Esc closes the hotkey's other options.
